limitations_and_boundaries: The study focuses on node classification tasks and may not generalize to other graph learning tasks.

The analysis is limited to the datasets Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed.
The adaptive residual mechanism relies on the assumption that abnormal features lead to larger adaptive scores, which may not hold in all scenarios.
